- .github/workflows/clarify.yml:437-449
  TASK_GAP: A non-numeric `GH_RETRY_MAX_ATTEMPTS` can make the comparison return 2, which the `if` treats as false, so the loop keeps sleeping until job timeout. `${GH_RETRY_MAX_ATTEMPTS:-3}` defaults unset/empty values but not non-numeric values.
  Suggested minimal fix: Validate once at definition time: `local max_attempts="${GH_RETRY_MAX_ATTEMPTS:-3}"; case "${max_attempts}" in ''|*[!0-9]*) max_attempts=3 ;; esac` then reference the validated value.
  HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml:434-449
  TASK_GAP: The fallback retries unconditionally on any non-zero exit, including non-retryable 4xx errors; a persistent 4xx incurs backoff before failing.
  Suggested minimal fix: After a failed attempt, inspect the last line of stderr for `HTTP 4\d\d`; on a definitive 4xx, log a distinct warning and return 1 immediately without further retries. Keep the catch-all retry when status parsing fails.
  HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
